leadText:
Emmy (Japanese: エミー Emmy) is a character of the day who appeared in The Dragon Master's Path!.

Emmy appeared after her was spotted by and . It attacked them, but soon after, found the source of Druddigon's anger. Emmy seemed to have trouble battling with her Pokémon, so Iris offered her help since she wants to become a Dragon Master. Ash suggested a with her, and Emmy accepted. Iris served as Emmy's coach during the match.

During the battle, Emmy used Druddigon against Ash's Tepig. With help from Iris, Emmy and Druddigon were able to defeat Ash's Tepig. Soon after, appeared and stole Druddigon and . As Team Rocket escaped, Druddigon and Axew were able to cause Team Rocket's mecha to fall down, and Ash and the others soon caught up. During the battle with Team Rocket, Druddigon was able to use , and then, Axew was able to successfully use to finish Team Rocket off.
